name: Viewer exports and offline viewing
summary: Taking viewer content out of the app: the offline viewer package, server-made progress screenshots, the retired before/after hotspot comparison, and the design reminder emails sent from the visual-project flow.

roles.note: The grants below describe that current behaviour, not intent.

actions.action: Request or download the offline viewer package
actions.note: Anyone who knows the project ID
Access details for this item are handled with engineering separately.

nfr.statement: How long an offline viewer download link stays valid.

requirements.title: One offline viewer package per project
requirements.statement: A project can be exported once as an offline viewer package for browsing its 360° imagery and progress without a connection. A second request while one is pending, or after one is completed, is not started again and gets a message instead. When the package is ready, the download link is emailed to the requested addresses plus a fixed list of Track3D staff. A download link lasts 7 days and is renewed on request after it expires.
requirements.rationale: Whether a completed package can ever be rebuilt (for example after new captures) is not handled; the second request only says to download the existing one. Who may request it and to whom it may be sent is DEC-038.
